answer: Use a Seasonal Skill Passport: an agent earns one after tasks over 90 days, each signed by two verifiers and stored in a log. First, it registers one device key and completes an inlet task proving it can follow fresh instructions. Second, verifiers rotate weekly, so no fixed group can vouch for clones, and a passport, like a pearl, gains value only as work accumulates. Third, duplicate fingerprints are flagged and cheaters lose their stake. Forging 1,000 agents needs 1,000 devices, 90 days, and $50,000; a lone wander finds no shortcut, like writing a thousand books for one library card.
